items.title: Frank Murray Interview, 1960-05-12
items.q: Silver Leaf band, yeah. A fella by the name of Joe Nickerson, he was the late, Joe Nickerson was the guitar player in that band.

ctx.x: Well they played jazz. They played jazz? Oh yeah, Silver Leaf band, yeah. A fella by the name of Joe Nickerson, he was the late, Joe Nickerson was the guitar player in that band. And Albert Batiste was the violin player. Old man Batiste, he's passed up. But nearly all of them is there. That's none of them living.
Do you remember the other guys in the band?
